entry_state: Origin-matched cessation retains gross cash origins and tests liquidity before receipts. Purchase moves the hedge reserve into inventory basis without new income or cash. Later sales allocate carrying cost and allowance only to remaining goods;recovery cannot restore allowance on goods already sold. Equal final totals can conceal wrong interim statements. Net hedges preserve gross transactions and their earnings periods,including qualifying nil-net positions. The new IFRS2 award section separates service/non-market vesting from market conditions;its first subsection continues after222.
exit_state: Cash-settled awards remeasure their liability;equity awards retain grant-date cost subject to the relevant vesting conditions. Settlement chooser and actual cash obligation determine treatment. Beneficial modifications add incremental cost on its own service clock. Participation reallocates ordinary earnings when assumed shares change,including senior/capped rights. Restricted additive gross effects admit an ordered calculation;shared bonus/tax effects can be nonadditive. Complete conditional EPS worlds do not establish a valid dilution selector. The dependent-EPS subsection continues with contingent similar instruments after228.

findings.observation: The award cases distinguish remeasurement,cancellation,beneficial modification and settlement choice. The two service clocks and cash-to-equity example make the prior balance and measurement date relevant to each increment.

Capped participation recalculates both numerator and denominator. Its ordering proof is restricted to complete additive gross effects. The shared-bonus counterexample then shows why isolated effects cannot be summed,and explicitly leaves nonadditive selection unresolved.
